import sys
sys.setrecursionlimit(300000)

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    idx = 0
    
    T = int(data[idx])
    idx += 1
    
    results = []
    
    for _ in range(T):
        N = int(data[idx])
        idx += 1
        
        S_str = data[idx]
        idx += 1
        
        adj = [[] for _ in range(N + 1)]
        for _ in range(N - 1):
            u = int(data[idx])
            v = int(data[idx + 1])
            idx += 2
            adj[u].append(v)
            adj[v].append(u)
        
        Q = int(data[idx])
        idx += 1
        
        parent = [0] * (N + 1)
        depth = [0] * (N + 1)
        up = [[0] * 20 for _ in range(N + 1)]
        char_mask = [0] * (N + 1)
        
        for i in range(1, N + 1):
            char_mask[i] = 1 << (ord(S_str[i - 1]) - ord('a'))
        
        stack = [1]
        visited = [False] * (N + 1)
        visited[1] = True
        parent[1] = 1
        depth[1] = 0
        
        while stack:
            u = stack.pop()
            for v in adj[u]:
                if not visited[v]:
                    visited[v] = True
                    parent[v] = u
                    depth[v] = depth[u] + 1
                    stack.append(v)
        
        for i in range(1, N + 1):**
            up[i][0] = parent[i]
        for j in range(1, 20):
            for i in range(1, N + 1):
                up[i][j] = up[up[i][j - 1]][j - 1]
        
        def get_lca(u, v):
            if depth[u] < depth[v]:
                u, v = v, u
            diff = depth[u] - depth[v]
            for j in range(20):
                if (diff >> j) & 1:
                    u = up[u][j]
            if u == v:
                return u
            for j in range(19, -1, -1):
                if up[u][j] != up[v][j]:
                    u = up[u][j]
                    v = up[v][j]
            return parent[u]
        
        def get_path_mask(u, lca):
            mask = 0
            curr = u
            while curr != lca:
                mask |= char_mask[curr]
                curr = parent[curr]
            return mask
        
        for _ in range(Q):
            U = int(data[idx])
            V = int(data[idx + 1])
            idx += 2
            
            lca = get_lca(U, V)
            
            mask_u = get_path_mask(U, lca)
            mask_v = get_path_mask(V, lca)
            
            if mask_u & mask_v:
                results.append("YES")
            else:
                results.append("NO")
    
    sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(results) + '\n')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
